title: Development works for promotion of tourism at Chetlath Lighthouse.
summary: E-tender (two-cover) for development works to promote tourism at Chetlat Lighthouse, Chetlat Island, UT of Lakshadweep (Kochi Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Chetlath Lighthouse, Chetlath, U T of Lakshadweep-682 554
sites.work: Development works for promotion of tourism

scope.item: Development works for promotion of tourism at Chetlath Lighthouse

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents by post or in person before deadline. Tender fee Nil. Bid Securing Declaration also required.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies; OR for Lakshadweep contractors, work experience with any Government department in island works during last 7 years
Similar works in last 7 years: three each >= 40%, two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost

Similar works: roof sheet truss work of multistorey building, solar frame truss work, waterproofing, construction of residential/institutional/office buildings, lighthouse tower etc. or related civil construction
PAN and GST registration; CA-certified annual turnover of last three years
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper of not blacklisted; undertaking listing gazetted/accounts officer relatives in MoPSW/DGLL
Copy of EPF/labour registration certificate; Tender Acceptance Letter; Bid Securing Declaration
notes: Section I NIT only (printed pages 2-4); no file number, BOQ or description of the tourism works. Bid download/submission 27.10.2025 18:00 to 13.11.2025 15:00; bid query deadline 05.11.2025 15:00; last date of original EMD 12.11.2025 15:00; technical bid opening 14.11.2025 15:00. Listing shows bid opening 2025-09-14, which conflicts with the document (14.11.2025).
